cc:Work.dc:title: Box - IrregularBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with an irregular polygon as base
Provide consecutive polygon vertices as ``--points`` (space-separated ``x,y`` pairs in mm). The outline is closed automatically.
For short side walls that don't fit a connecting finger reduce *surroundingspaces* and *finger* in the Finger Joint Settings.
The lids need to be glued.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes IrregularBox --output examples/IrregularBox.svg Command line short: boxes IrregularBox --output

text.style: font-family: sans-serif ; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; fill: rgb(255,0,0)
